Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really useful conversation. Below is a short recap of what we covered and the proposed next steps so we all have the same alignment.

Recap of pain points and goals:
- Regulated data (PHI): FinHealth needs an inference solution that ensures data never leaves your VPC and that we provide customer-managed key (CMK) support + audit logs.
- Network constraints: On-premise gateway + limited outbound connectivity; possibility of an air-gapped deployment for certain workloads.
- Key management: Must integrate with existing KMS/HSM (AWS KMS and Thales HSM evaluated).
- Performance requirements: 1000 QPS peak for batch scoring (non-real-time), and sub-200ms P95 for low-latency endpoints used by clinician UI.
- Model preferences: Evaluate open Llama-3 style models (quantized) and a Redwood-curated performance profile; also want to compare to your internal small LLMs for cost/accuracy tradeoffs.
- Success criteria: data residency in VPC, customer key ownership, SOC2-aligned audit trail, meeting latency SLOs under expected concurrency.

Current stack you described:
- Primary cloud: AWS (us-west-2) with dedicated VPCs per environment
- Identity: Okta SSO, mTLS for internal services
- Network: Corporate firewall with strict egress rules; some teams run in air-gapped gov-cloud-like environments

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) I’ll share a short SOW draft and an initial network requirements checklist (attached).
2) Please share a network diagram (we discussed you’d get that to us this week).
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security leads to go through KMS/HSM integration and air-gap options — suggested window: next Wed/Thu.
4) Follow up on legal/procurement: we’ll provide an SSO and security questionnaire export for your legal team.

Attachments included in this email: SOW-draft-FinHealth-v1.docx, FinHealth-security-reqs.xlsx

If I missed anything or you want a different priority/order, let me know. Otherwise I’ll schedule the technical deep-dive and loop in our solutions engineer.

Thanks,

--

Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap. This looks right to us. A few clarifications/questions from our side:

- Air-gap: We have one critical environment that must be fully air-gapped. Can you confirm whether Redwood’s private/on-prem package supports an air-gapped install (no outbound) and what the deployment cadence looks like for model updates in that mode?
- KMS/HSM: We use AWS KMS for most workloads but are evaluating Thales in a limited zone. We need explicit guidance on how key rotation and key ownership will work.
- Network diagram: attaching a redacted network diagram (FinHealth-network-diagram.png) — it shows the segmentation and the connectivity chokepoints we mentioned.

Thanks Aisha — great, Thursday 2026-11-26 10:00am PT is confirmed on my calendar. Quick notes in response to your questions:

- Air-gapped deployment: Yes — Redwood Private supports an air-gapped install. In that mode we deliver a deployment bundle and supporting operator tooling that your infra team runs in the isolated environment. Model updates are delivered via signed artifact bundles and need an infra-side approval step; frequency can be configured (e.g., monthly, on-demand). We’ll include a short runbook in the deep-dive.
- KMS/HSM: We support integrating with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) and can integrate with HSMs like Thales via PKCS#11 adapters. Key rotation and ownership remain with FinHealth; Redwood stores only encrypted references and records key-change events in audit logs. We’ll bring a solutions engineer to the deep-dive to walk through the rotation workflow.
- Network diagram: received — thanks for sharing. We’ll mark the egress chokepoints and include a proposed connectivity pattern for private deployments in the technical pack.

Attached: SOW-draft-FinHealth-v1.docx (updated cover), FinHealth-security-reqs.xlsx

Action items I’ll own:
- Week-of 11/23: send a technical checklist and runbook for air-gapped installs
- Prior to 11/26: solutions engineer deep-dive invite + agenda
- Post deep-dive: formal SOW + procurement timelines

See you Thursday.

Best,
